# WP57d review: Appendix E as "Assumptions, limitations and open questions", and Appendix H

Branch `wp57d` (worktree off `dev` at 2db089d5), one commit holding E and H (the notebook carries both, and each commit is to pass the suite on its own). Counts by
`work-packages/WP57-rounds/map_counts.py --paper paper/paper.ipynb --supp paper/supporting_material.ipynb`:
`WP57-rounds/d/counts-before.txt` (2db089d5) and `counts-after.txt`. Captures and the unit's cold read:
`WP57-rounds/d/*.png`, `WP57-rounds/d/cold-read.md`.

## What was built

**E.1 Assumptions** (G1 part 1). Two tables generated by `paper/generate_gaps.py` from `derivation/axioms.py` and the
proof map's record, nothing typed but their captions: `assumptions_table` (A0 to A11, R1 to R3: id, the ledger's
statement in one line, the section of the paper that states it, the results whose scripts import it, each a link to
its proof in B) and `cited_table` (I1 to I18, F5 to F19: id, statement, the ledger's citation, the results). The one
line is the ledger's own headline (`one_line`: the words before the first colon when three or more, else the
statement to its first semicolon, a closing aside dropped); "Stated in" is found in `paper.ipynb` (the first
`{prf:assumption} X,` or `X: `), A0 "not in the main text"; an entry no lemma imports says why, from the module's
`STRUCTURAL`, `CITED_CONTEXT` and `SOLVER_LEVEL`. R rows are ordered R1, R2, R3 (the ledger's dict holds R1, R3, R2).

**E.2 Limitations** (G1 part 2, G2). One typed table, a row per item: the section it left (a `{numref}` or `{ref}` role,
so the site prints the number), what is not established, its record. Then Table 3, `gaps_table` in four columns (gap
with its title as a link to its line of the ledger, bridging assumption, what cannot be proved, interpretive
consequence); the formal object and the sensitivity evidence stay in `docs/superpowers/notes/abstraction-gaps.md`.

**E.3 Open questions** (G1 part 3). One typed table: OQ-1 to OQ-10 and OQ-12 to OQ-14 in the ledger's order, each the
ledger's title (the old "(Q1)" to "(Q4)" labels dropped) with the section it bears on and its record, then the two
research questions of Section 9. OQ-11 (closed) is absent. Each open entry of `work-packages/review/open-questions.md`
gains one line, "Listed: Appendix E.3 of the supporting material (WP57d)", nothing else.

**H** (G3). The Job block cut; H.1's sentence "This appendix is a prospectively specified follow-up ..., not a
performance benchmark" cut (C591 retires); H.2 to H.4 kept; H.5 moved to `notes/directions/wp35-horopca-formalism-and-
solvers.md` (no HoroPCA readout was in `notes/directions/`, so a new file named for it, the scope's default), cited by
one line at the end of H.4. The check first: no sentence of Sections 2 to 9 needs H.5. Section 2's HoroPCA paragraph
says "maximizing a variance" and cites H for the test; the register of prior art (G.1, C536, C537) carries the
nonconvex-versus-convex contrast. E.2 lists H.4's reading limits (a) to (c) by reference, not repeated.

**Pointers** (G4). Section 6's "Appendix E records what the results leave open" and Section 9's "(Appendix E)" resolve
to the renamed section (anchor `appendix-e` kept); Section 2's HoroPCA sentence resolves to H. No main-text edit.

Where the map's 2.1 (read on wp55) and the paper differ, the paper won: 2.1's Section 5 items "zero metrics mask their
row without a warning" and "the labels are an implementation choice", Section 7's "threshold limits illustrative",
Section 8's "the triples' fits are not the case's K = 2 fit" and "not an estimate of a rate", 2.1's B.2 "L19 is used by
no result" and D.14's "status depends on the platform" are not in the paper as it stands and are not listed. The
coverage probability's constants (Section 9's limits) are OQ-13; log-convexity is OQ-10, not a second E.2 row. The
successive-trade-offs question has no readout in `notes/directions/`: its record is the design specification
(`notes/2026-11-07-posynomial-invariant-form-design.md`, which states it) and the choosing-K guide.

Q4, Q6, Q8, Q9; Q5's last sentence), two as E.3 research questions (Q5, Q7), and Q2 covered by E.2's L15 and L16 rows
and OQ-5.

is now `test_no_appendix_opens_with_a_job_block` (`JOB_BLOCKS` gone); the gaps typesetting test reads the titles and
